userPrompt:
preciso de um componente web que mostre os dados em formato de tabela.
- deve permitir alterar a largura das colunas
- deve permitir alterar a ordem das colunas

groupSkill.description: Displays structured data in tabular format. Data provided via TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, and TableCell slot tags. Supports column sorting, row selection with checkboxes, pagination, and isEditing propagation to web components inside cells. Implementations include data table, simple table, editable grid, virtualized table, and tree table.
